Choosing the right pet products: size, pet type & usage guide

Selecting the right pet product starts with understanding your pet and your living space. At IKEA, we simplify this process with practical designs and intuitive solutions.
Size matters
Choose products that allow your pet to move, rest and stretch comfortably. Compact options work well in smaller spaces, while larger pets benefit from more spacious and supportive designs.
Pet type considerations

Cats often prefer enclosed or elevated spaces where they feel secure, while dogs usually enjoy open, cushioned areas for relaxation. Our designs reflect these natural preferences.
Usage and lifestyle
Consider how your pet interacts with their environment. Active pets may require more durable, easy-to-clean materials, while indoor pets benefit from softer, comfort-focused designs.

Everyday convenience
We design products that adapt to your routine, helping you create a setup that is both functional and easy to maintain.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Q1: What types of pet products are available at IKEA?
We offer pet beds, cushions, feeding bowls, mats, storage solutions and play accessories. Each product is designed to combine comfort, functionality and style.

Q2: Are IKEA pet products suitable for both dogs and cats?
Yes, our products are designed to suit both dogs and cats, taking into account their different behaviours and comfort needs.

Q3: Are the materials used safe for pets?
Our products are made using non-toxic, carefully tested materials and include safety-focused design features.
